# OnerOS -- Complete Documentation

> OnerOS is an open-source, web-based operating system experience that brings a full desktop-like environment to the browser. It features window management, 7 visual themes (Fluent Valley, Modern, Centered, Win95, WinXP, macOS, Ubuntu), 15+ applications, Spotlight-style global search, and a unique Fluent Valley design language. Built with Vite, vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript, and zero runtime dependencies. Created by Klubuntu (https://klubuntu.eu.org). Licensed under GPL-3.0.

## Quick Start

### Try the Live Experience

Open [https://web-oneros.netlify.app](https://web-oneros.netlify.app) in any modern browser. No installation required.

### Run the Website Locally

```bash
git clone https://github.com/OnerOS-project/Website.git
cd Website
npm install
npm run dev
```

The development server starts at `http://localhost:5173`.

### Build for Production

```bash
npm run build
npm run preview
```

Production output is placed in `dist/`. Preview at `http://localhost:4173`.

## What is OnerOS

OnerOS is a web-based desktop environment that simulates a full operating system experience in the browser. It is NOT a real operating system -- it is a browser-based experience that feels like one.

### Key Features

- **Window Manager** -- open, close, focus, drag, resize, maximize, snap windows
- **7 Visual Themes** -- Fluent Valley (default), Modern, Centered, Windows 95, Windows XP, macOS, Ubuntu
- **15+ Applications** -- Settings, Personalization, DevZone, Linux Mode (terminal), MPlayer, Calculator, Tools, WinSync, KDialer, and ecosystem apps
- **Global Search** -- Spotlight-inspired Cmd/Ctrl+K search across all apps, settings, and features
- **Personalization** -- change themes, wallpapers, and accent colors in real-time
- **Fluent Valley Design Language** -- original design system with glass surfaces, spatial depth, and system-inspired motion

### Architecture (Web Preview)

- Built with React 18 and TypeScript
- Centralized application registry
- Modular theme system with CSS custom properties
- Window management with drag, resize, snap, minimize, maximize
- Boot sequence with loading screen

### Architecture (Website)

- Built with Vite (vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript)
- Zero runtime dependencies
- Fluent Valley design token system (colors, typography, spacing, shadows, motion, surfaces)
- Interactive Apps Showcase with live previews
- Theme Showcase with 7 interactive theme previews
- Spotlight-style global search (Cmd/Ctrl+K)
- Responsive design (1440px, 1024px, 768px, 480px, 360px)
- Reduced motion support (`prefers-reduced-motion`)
- Keyboard-accessible throughout

## Themes

OnerOS ships with 7 visual themes. Each theme transforms the entire interface.

| Theme | Accent Color | Style |
|---|---|---|
| Fluent Valley (OnerOS 2026) | #60a5fa | Glass blur, floating surfaces, spatial depth |
| Modern | #47b895 | Clean, glass surfaces, subtle depth |
| Centered | #60a5fa | Floating taskbar, centered layout |
| Windows 95 | #000080 | Classic teal desktop, gray UI panels |
| Windows XP | #3164c5 | Luna blue theme, gradient surfaces |
| macOS | #0066cc | Traffic light controls, frosted glass |
| Ubuntu | #e95420 | Aubergine palette, orange accent |

## Applications

### System

- **Settings** -- Configure system preferences, display, audio, network, and application settings
- **Personalization** -- Customize wallpapers, accent colors, and themes
- **Tools** -- System utilities including screenshot, monitor, clipboard, recorder, color picker, and notes

### Productivity

- **DevZone** -- Developer tools including JSON formatter, Base64 encoder, color picker, and code snippets
- **Linux Mode** -- A simulated Linux terminal with 24+ built-in commands

### Media

- **MPlayer** -- Music player with vinyl animation, playlist management, and audio visualizer

### Utilities

- **Calculator** -- Fully functional calculator with basic arithmetic operations
- **WinSync** -- Windows sync tools including clipboard, file transfer, QR codes, links, and notes
- **KDialer** -- Phone dialer with contacts management and recent calls history

### Ecosystem (External)

- **ReVideeo** ([revideeo.app](https://revideeo.app)) -- Open-source video editor
- **ReImaage** ([reimaage-app.vercel.app](https://reimaage-app.vercel.app/)) -- Open-source image editor
- **iVOD** ([vod.itvt.xyz](https://vod.itvt.xyz)) -- Video-on-demand platform
- **Calculator** ([calculator-a.vercel.app](https://calculator-a.vercel.app/)) -- Standalone calculator app
- **Google** -- Web search in an OnerOS window
- **Facebook** -- Social media in an OnerOS window
- **Bing** -- Microsoft Bing search in an OnerOS window

## Design System

The website uses the Fluent Valley design language adapted for web.

### Design Tokens

- **Colors** -- accent (#47b895 teal), backgrounds (#0f1115 dark), text hierarchy, borders
- **Typography** -- System font stack, 14px to 48px scale
- **Spacing** -- 4px base scale (space-1 through space-32)
- **Shadows** -- 5-level elevation system (elevation-0 through elevation-4)
- **Motion** -- 4-tier hierarchy (micro 100ms, small 200ms, medium 350ms, large 500ms)
- **Surfaces** -- Base, raised, elevated, floating, glass (with backdrop-filter support)

### Surface Primitives

- `.surface` -- base card with border and hover transition
- `.surface--elevated` -- shadow and lift on hover
- `.surface--glass` -- backdrop blur with glass border
- `.surface--interactive` -- scale-down on press
- `.reveal` / `.reveal--visible` -- intersection observer scroll reveal
- `.stagger` -- staggered reveal delays

## Project Structure

```
Website/
  index.html                 # Main page (single-page website)
  vite.config.js             # Vite configuration
  package.json               # Project metadata
  sitemap.xml                # Sitemap for oneros.in
  netlify.toml               # Netlify deployment config
  llms.txt                   # LLM-friendly project summary
  llms-full.txt              # This file -- complete documentation
  public/
    favicon.ico
    robots.txt
    og-image.svg             # Open Graph social sharing image (1200x630)
    404.html
    assets/
      logo.svg               # Primary SVG logo
      logo-mono.svg          # Monochrome variant
      logo-mark.svg          # Compact mark
    img/
      hero-preview.png       # Hero section screenshot
      Preview - Win95.jpg
      Preview - Personalization.jpg
      Wallpaper.jpg
  css/
    tokens/                  # Design tokens
      colors.css
      typography.css
      spacing.css
      shadows.css
      motion.css
      surfaces.css
    components/              # Reusable components
      navigation.css         # Floating dock nav
      search.css             # Spotlight search overlay
      surfaces.css           # Surface primitives + reveal
    sections/                # Section-specific styles
      hero.css
      features.css
      themes.css
      apps.css
      preview.css
      ecosystem.css
      opensource.css
      footer.css
    globals.css              # Reset + base styles
    responsive.css           # Responsive overrides
  js/
    app.js                   # Core: nav, search, features, scroll reveal
    apps.js                  # Application data model (ES module)
    apps-showcase.js         # Interactive app launcher + previews
    theme-showcase.js        # Interactive 7-theme preview
  404.html                   # Custom 404 page
```

## Website Sections

1. **Hero** -- Full-viewport brand entrance with OnerOS logo, tagline, CTAs, and Fluent Valley screenshot
2. **Features** -- Interactive tab-based feature explorer (Window Manager, Themes, Applications, Personalization, Search)
3. **Themes** -- 7-theme showcase with live preview surface that transitions between themes
4. **Apps** -- Interactive application launcher with 7 rich previews (Settings, Personalization, DevZone, Linux Mode, MPlayer, Calculator, ReVideeo) and a functional calculator
5. **Web Preview** -- Three showcase cards linking to the live OnerOS experience
6. **Ecosystem** -- Project cards for ReVideeo, ReImaage, iVOD, Calculator
7. **Open Source** -- Stats, GitHub link, contributing info
8. **Footer** -- Links, social media, copyright

## SEO and Social

- **Title:** OnerOS -- An Open-Source Web Operating System Experience
- **Description:** Window management, 7 visual themes, built-in applications, and the Fluent Valley design language -- all running in your browser.
- **Canonical URL:** https://oneros.in
- **Open Graph:** title, description, image (1200x630 SVG), site_name, type
- **Twitter Card:** summary_large_image
- **Favicon:** /favicon.ico (ICO format from oneros.in)
- **robots.txt:** allows all crawlers
- **sitemap.xml:** single page entry for https://oneros.in/

## Technical Details

### Performance

- Total bundle (gzipped): ~28 KB (CSS + JS)
- Zero runtime dependencies
- Build time: ~110ms
- Static deployment on Netlify

### Accessibility

- Semantic HTML (header, main, nav, footer, section)
- ARIA labels on interactive elements
- Keyboard navigation throughout (search, features, themes, apps)
- Focus-visible states on all interactive elements
- `prefers-reduced-motion` support
- Minimum 44px touch targets

### Responsive Breakpoints

- 1440px: Full layout
- 1024px: Adaptive grid
- 768px: Stacked layout, hamburger navigation
- 480px: Compact layout
- 360px: Minimum viable layout
